authority.source_authority: DAD retains repository authority; Lowell retains product, privacy, budget, notification, release, and activation authority.

non_overlap_statement: The integration foreman owns shared registries, CLI wiring, branch integration, and final conflict resolution; persistence and recovery specialists may write only their assigned new modules, schemas, references, and focused tests; the independent checker is read-only.

roles.why_needed: The approved plan spans existing portfolio, graph, agent-family, CLI, daemon, and validation surfaces.
roles.mission: Preserve prior work, integrate disjoint outputs, maintain authority boundaries, wire shared interfaces, and produce complete validation evidence.
inputs: existing recovery and AI-native pilot work
roles.authority: May write the integration worktree and commit explicitly approved preservation work; may not push, merge, deploy, activate schedules, or mutate external systems.
acceptance_conditions: All planned contracts are implemented or explicitly fail-closed and reported
No private payload or authority widening is introduced
stop_conditions: A change would enable external mutation or persistent notification without a reviewed gate

roles.why_needed: Durable plan and semantic identity persistence is a separable, schema-heavy subsystem.
roles.mission: Implement append-only intent/plan persistence, durable semantic entities, deterministic related-work matching, and focused tests.
inputs: existing portfolio event and relation patterns
roles.authority: May write only new plan/entity modules, their schemas, and focused tests in the integration worktree; no shared CLI or registry edits.
acceptance_conditions: Private plans are stored only under initialized DAD data root
stop_conditions: Raw conversations or secrets would be persisted
Identity ambiguity is treated as authority
Shared-file changes are required without foreman handoff

roles.why_needed: Partial-build reconciliation and weekly digest behavior are separable from identity persistence.
roles.mission: Implement deterministic build-state recovery, changed-only weekly digest, specialist-pack contracts, and focused tests.
roles.authority: May write only new recovery/digest modules, PM specialist-pack references, and focused tests; no shared CLI or registry edits.
acceptance_conditions: Unchanged cycles use zero model calls
stop_conditions: A second attention queue is created
Notification or schedule activation is implied

roles.why_needed: Identity, privacy, authority, automation, and recovery controls have broad downstream consequences.
roles.mission: Independently verify contracts, tests, privacy boundaries, authority invariants, negative cases, and release readiness.
roles.authority: Read-only review; may not edit implementation, approve its own work, push, merge, deploy, or activate automation.
acceptance_conditions: Security and authority negative cases are rerun
Release gate and remaining risks are explicit

readiness_conditions: Integrated diff and tests are available

proof_obligations.description: Prove plan capture creates no project, workstream, priority, lease, reminder, dependency, or execution authority.
Prove similarity remains candidate evidence and cannot silently merge identities or cross privacy partitions.
Prove recovery and weekly digest projections do not mutate Git or create a second attention queue.
Prove the integrated capability OS remains schema-valid and preserves existing portfolio behavior.
evidence_required: full pytest result or exact timeout report
